lines.text: Many learners say: He plays his phone all day.
Better: He plays with his phone all day.
With! The baby plays with a toy.

data.wrong: He plays his phone all day.
data.right: He plays with his phone all day.

native.hook: 玩手机别漏 with 哦！
native.tip: 中文说“玩手机”，动词后面直接接东西。英语里玩东西要加 with：play with his phone。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He plays his phone all day.”😅 中文“玩手机”直接接，英语要加 with：“He plays with his phone all day.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He plays with his phone all day.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: Don’t miss out on using your mobil
en.tip: Chinese puts the thing right after the verb, but English needs with.
en.caption: Do you say “He plays his phone all day.” 😅 English needs with after play: “He plays with his phone all day.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
